instruction: Typed Office Layout With Material Quantities Use the opened Bonsai IFC authoring environment to modify /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc into a typed office layout and export a material quantity table. You may use /home/user/Desktop/init_plan.png as a local reference image. Save the outputs as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv. The IFC4 model must contain one project, one site, one building, and one storey named Ground Floor; five spaces; seven walls; one slab; four doors; three windows; seven openings; seven void relationships; seven fill relationships; and four materials. Do not include proxies, furniture, roofs, columns, beams, stairs, or flow terminals, and keep every IfcRoot GlobalId unique. Create spaces named Lobby, Office A, Office B, Meeting, and WC with clear plan sizes 3.60 m by 2.80 m, 3.60 m by 6.40 m, 3.60 m by 9.40 m, 3.40 m by 4.40 m, and 3.40 m by 4.60 m respectively; all spaces must be 2.80 m high. Name the walls Wall-S, Wall-N, Wall-W, Wall-E, Part-1, Part-2, and Part-3 with dimensions 12.00 m by 0.20 m by 3.00 m, 12.00 m by 0.20 m by 3.00 m, 0.20 m by 10.00 m by 3.00 m, 0.20 m by 10.00 m by 3.00 m, 0.20 m by 9.60 m by 3.00 m, 0.20 m by 9.60 m by 3.00 m, and 3.80 m by 0.20 m by 3.00 m. Name the slab Office Slab and make it 12.00 m by 10.00 m by 0.20 m. Assign all spaces, walls, slab, doors, and windows to Ground Floor. The CSV must use the exact headers GlobalId, Class, TypeName, MaterialSummary, NetArea, NetVolume and contain one row for Office Slab plus one row for each wall, matched by GlobalId. Office Slab must report Class IfcSlab, TypeName OfficeSlabType, MaterialSummary Concrete:0.200m, NetArea 120.0, and NetVolume 24.0. Each wall must report Class IfcWall, TypeName OfficeWallType, and MaterialSummary Brick:0.120m | Insulation:0.050m | Gypsum:0.015m. NetArea/NetVolume must be Wall-S 36.0/7.2, Wall-N 36.0/7.2, Wall-W 30.0/6.0, Wall-E 30.0/6.0, Part-1 5.76/5.76, Part-2 5.76/5.76, and Part-3 2.28/2.28. Other representation details may vary. [Software] Bonsai workflows are used together with Blender; start Blender with `blender` (adjust path if needed).
